source.note: Devnet deployment; program keypairs and address registry in ~/.config/omnipair/dusk-devnet. Binary attested from chain (upgradeable loader programdata). Re-pinned 2026-09-05 for the hLP reserve-identity fix (omnipair/dusk#18, merge a5d436fe): the concentrated hLP invariant now compares both sides in the curve-reserve domain, removing public unrealized lending interest from the raw live identity. Built at the Dusk-only opt-level s introduced by that PR (2,473,056 bytes). The previous binary (7183cdb29659e47e...) is preserved at dusk-keepers/artifacts/dusk-devnet-7183cdb2.so for rollback. source.worktreeFingerprintSha256 covers programs/ and is reproduced by scripts/compute-worktree-fingerprint.mjs.
